0022600005.text: Both teams have yet to play a 2026-27 game, and this is the Lakers' first game of the season, with ESPN's matchup predictor giving the Lakers a 65% win chance. The Lakers won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 119-103 win in San Francisco on April 9, 2026. Six Lakers are listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions: Adou Thiero, Bronny James, Cameron Carr, Collin Sexton, Dalton Knecht, and Jarred Vanderbilt, while the Warriors are without Jimmy Butler III, Kristaps Porzingis, and Moses Moody, with Brandin Podziemski, Charles Bassey, and Stephen Curry also day-to-day.
